title: Learning before a risky allocation — original synthetic laboratory
provenance: All laws, observations, costs and controls authored for this library on 7 October 2026. No real customers, market prices or October economic observations. Educational reuse with attribution is permitted by the project author.

units.counts: independent labeled Bernoulli trials conditional on their respective parameters

assumptions: Separate population-rate and state-stratified report-validation training experiments; no trial is reused across likelihood factors.
Independent beta priors on good-state prevalence p, sensitivity s and false-positive probability f; training likelihood factors by parameter.
Future state is good with probability p; report is positive with probability s when good and f when bad.
Actions invest or abstain have unchanged state-contingent payoffs; information can be ignored; a fee is paid once before report observation regardless of action.
The fixed-parameter simulation reference is an explicit educational world for sampling and out-of-sample checks; it is distinct from the posterior belief and does not replace it.
Multiple future observations in a posterior predictive experiment share latent parameters; independent draws at posterior means are a different experiment.
